An admin observation cannot stand in for member behavior.

The guest/member/admin duplicates in current result entries do not represent three distinct product roles. Keep role cells unverified or resolve their applicability at the inventory owner; shared scratch evidence should not be counted three times.
applicability.EXT-F-0003: Release validation and publication are authentication-independent infrastructure. The guest/member/admin duplicate fixture results do not demonstrate three identity-specific behaviors. They should be interpreted as one fixture outcome; release real-run evidence is also shared across modes.
